title: Linkable Error IDs and Remediation Recipes for Python/TS/Go SDKs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce compact, linkable error identifiers (RID codes) surfaced consistently across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, together with concise remediation recipes and language-specific snippets. Goal is to reduce time-to-resolution for developer-facing errors and provide deterministic guidance for automated retry/fallback logic.
background: Current SDK error surfaces vary in shape and content between languages: message text differs, error types/classes are inconsistent, and telemetry lacks a stable link to a canonical remediation document. This causes friction for customers troubleshooting transient vs terminal failures and for internal support to triage incidents across platforms.
scope: Add a stable error_id (format RID-<shorthash>) to all SDK exceptions and error objects; publish per-error canonical remediation page; include short 'remediation_hint' and 'retry_hint' on the error object; provide language-specific ergonomic wrappers for common recovery flows in Python/TS/Go; ensure errors emitted during streaming include resume tokens when available.
non_goals: Do not change existing HTTP status codes or server-side error semantics in this project. This initiative does not include automatic server-side remediation or self-healing; it focuses on SDK ergonomics and documentation.
design_decisions: Use compact linkable ID 'RID-xxxx' (4 hex chars) to keep error text compact in logs and telemetry
Carry three canonical fields on every cross-language error: error_id, retry_hint (one of: none, safe-idempotent, conditional, unknown), remediation_hint (short text), doc_url
For streaming errors include optional 'resume_token' when server returns partial state; SDKs expose a helper to attach resume_token to subsequent requests
Map existing SDK-specific exception classes to a limited set of cross-language categories: Transient, RateLimit, Auth, InvalidRequest, ModelQuality, Internal
Expose both typed exceptions (language idiomatic) and a common 'RawError' with stable fields for telemetry and automated tooling
migration_plan: Phase 1: Server adds canonical error_id and doc_url to API error envelope (backend PR reference in comments)
Phase 2: SDKs (Python/TS/Go) add parsing and augmentation to their error objects; keep backward-compatible message fields
Phase 3: Docs team publishes remediation pages for top 50 errors; link short RID codes to pages
Phase 4: Telemetry dashboards updated to surface error_id and remediation category for easier debugging
testing_plan: Unit tests for error parsing and propagation across 3 SDKs
Integration tests simulating transient errors, streaming interruptions with resume_token, and auth failures
E2E smoke test that validates doc_url resolves and remediation_hint is present in SDK error payload
Load test to ensure attaching error fields does not materially change payload sizes or latency
rollout_plan: Release SDKs with default opt-in for enriched errors in minor releases; flag to opt-out for customers with strict schema parsing
After one week of opt-in telemetry, flip to opt-out for broad availability unless customers explicitly disable
Coordinate with Console and Support: include quick reference in runbook and support playbooks
Monitor error-volume dashboards for unexpected spikes correlating with SDK version rollouts
acceptance_criteria: All three SDKs surface error_id and doc_url on thrown/returned error objects
SDKs provide at least one language-idiomatic helper for retry decisions using retry_hint
Streaming error payloads include resume_token in error object when server provides it
Docs published for top 50 errors and linked from error doc_url
No regressions in existing unit/integration tests; latency impact <1ms median for error paths
tasks: Backend: include error_id and doc_url in API error envelope (ENG-BE-#)
Python SDK: parse fields and expose RichError with properties error_id,retry_hint,remediation_hint,doc_url
TS SDK: extend Error classes and network-layer typedefs; add helper makeRetryDecision()
Go SDK: implement error wrapper preserving original error types and stable fields
Docs: create /errors/RID-xxxx pages for top 50 errors and templated remediation recipe
Telemetry: add error_id dimension to SDK events and Console dashboards
QA: add integration tests for streaming resume_token and retry workflows
